N1 — Layer Impact Completion Gate (north-star priority A). For a given changed-file set, decide which of DDD/SDD/BDD/TDD/ADR record layers are impacted vs updated and emit a Unified Result Schema document conforming to schemas/layer-impact-result.schema.json. v0.1: N2 reference-resolver is wired in, so candidateRecords carries path-stem/test-stem/ADR-keyword matches with scores and resolverVersion is populated. Observation mode (exit 0) until host-project pilot.

N2 — Map-aware Reference Resolver (north-star priority B). For each changed source file, find candidate record files across DDD/SDD/BDD/TDD/ADR/SSOT layers using four resolution strategies: cross-layer-link (score 1.0), test-stem sibling (0.95), path-stem (0.85/0.55), ADR keyword (0.4-0.7). Persists an index cache at generated/reference-index.json keyed by sha1 fingerprint; consumed by lazy-layer-impact-gate to enrich candidateRecords with explicit scores. Exits 0 always (informational).
